name: Maya Okafor
bio: Maya opened Stillroom in 2016 after twelve years in NHS and university counselling services.
days: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday · In person and online
approach: Integrative therapy draws on several schools of thought, chosen around the person in front of her.

name: Isla Grant
bio: Isla works in short, structured blocks with people who are exhausted by keeping everything going.
days: Tuesday and Wednesday, until 8pm · In person and online
approach: Cognitive behavioural therapy with practical, manageable steps between sessions.

name: Ruth Hallam
bio: Ruth has sat with grief for over twenty years, in hospices first and at Stillroom since 2018.
approach: A steady, compassionate place to make room for grief and change.

name: Tom Reid
bio: Tom helps couples hear each other again, whether they decide to stay together or not.
days: Monday and Thursday evenings, Saturday mornings · In person and online
approach: Relational work that slows conversations down so each person can be heard.

name: Clara Lindqvist
bio: Clara teaches slow, practical breathing for people whose bodies are stuck on high alert.
approach: Slow breathing and body awareness, taught in a practical four-session course.

name: Arjun Mehta
bio: Arjun works with the things people have carried for years and never found words for.
days: Tuesday and Thursday, until 8pm · In person and online
approach: Psychotherapy and EMDR for experiences and memories that still feel present.

name: Hannah Bryce
bio: Hannah looks at food alongside sleep, stress and routine, never as a diet.
days: Wednesday and Friday · In person and online
approach: Nutrition support grounded in everyday routines, sleep, stress and food.

name: Daniel Moffat
bio: Daniel works mostly with people in their twenties working out who they are becoming.
days: Monday and Friday, Saturday mornings · In person and online
approach: Counselling for identity, relationships and the transitions of early adulthood.
